headline: Sep 16 PM · Second morning in a row the AM brief never fired, so this PM carries the day again — and nothing underneath it moved. The Sep 16 digest landed on time (15:00:06Z) digit-for-digit identical for the eighth straight day; the FA-ADS watchdog is ~142h dark and the Meta→CRM spend-sync ~122h silent with no success ever. Mary Grossman is five days past her callback with nothing written; compliance 0/7 on day 20; the one real NV lead still sits behind the gate. Everything still turns on one human minute: open the CRM, write Mary's outcome, call the paid motion.

spotlight.title: Mary Grossman — five days past, close it in writing
spotlight.detail: The Fri Sep 11 6:45 PM PT callback is now five days gone, and every business-day window since has passed with nothing written. Four consecutive digests (Sep 13-16) put the miss on the system of record — 0 booked, 3 unbooked, 3 SLA breached. First real $300-Plan lead (NV), NO TCPA consent → hand-dial only +1 805 302 2655. Ninth ask: one sentence in a lane — called / referred / held. It stays on the record until a human writes it.

spotlight.title: Open the CRM — the one look that settles two dead instruments
spotlight.detail: Eight identical digests (Sep 9→16) mean the scoreboard can no longer tell 'nothing happened' from 'reading a frozen table.' One minute in the CRM answers both open unknowns regardless of what the digest prints: (a) are there ad-spend rows stamped after Sep 11 13:32Z — w30, the sync question; (b) do the lead rows really show 3 with contact / 3 unbooked / 3 breached, or has the table not been written since Sep 9. Write the two answers into the board; do not infer either from silence.

spotlight.title: Day 20, 0/7 compliance, and the paid motion is running blind ~142h
spotlight.detail: Consumer flow went live Aug 27; twenty days later none of the seven blockers is closed — b3 (TX telephone-solicitor registration) and b7 (CA producer license #) are the two that gate the lead in hand. The FA-ADS watchdog has not run since Sep 10 17:06Z (~142h), so V2 spend (last read ~$72 of the $200 tranche) has had no reader for nearly six days. State the paid motion plainly — keep spending or hold — or restore what the watchdog runs on. Letting it drain by default is the one choice the board cannot accept.
